description: Reference MiniLM sentence vectors captured from the previous embedding backend (sentence-transformers 5.2.0 + torch all-MiniLM-L6-v2) immediately before the ONNX Runtime swap. tests/test_local_embedder.py re-encodes these texts with core/minilm_onnx.py and asserts cosine parity >= 0.9999 on every sample.
texts: Python Backend Developer with Django and PostgreSQL
machine learning engineer with PyTorch and TensorFlow experience
Data Analyst skilled in SQL, Excel, Power BI and Tableau dashboards
Represent this job posting for candidate matching: Build REST APIs with Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL. 3+ years required.

I am a final year B.Tech CSE student at VIT Vellore with internship experience in backend development using Django REST Framework, Redis, Celery and Docker. I have built a resume parsing pipeline and a recommendation engine.
